name: Luis Munoz Marin International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 08/26, is 10,400 ft x 193 ft (about 3,170 m); 10/28 is 8,016 ft x 150 ft

hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

customs.v: CBP general aviation inspection 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; call CBP before leaving the foreign port and at least 2 hours before arrival; park at the CBP inspection area at the FBO
customs.quote: 7 days per week, 24 hours per day

ppr.v: all private and corporate aircraft must contact airport operations before arrival for FBO and ground handling information (787-253-0979); military aircraft PPR 72 hours ahead
ppr.quote: ALL PVT AND CORPORATE AIRCRAFT MUST CONTACT ARPT OPS, BEFORE ARRIVAL, FOR FBOS & GROUND HANDLING INFO AT 787-253-0979.

fuel.v: 100 octane avgas and jet fuel (A+ / A++)

max_aircraft.v: taxiway J between J1 and J5 closed to aircraft with wingspan over 118 ft (no effect on business jets)
max_aircraft.quote: TWY J BTN J1 AND J5 (NOT INCLUDING J5) CLSD TO ACFT WITH GREATER THAN 118 FT WINGSPAN.
